messages:
maria chen: quick idea 1: add a per-tenant microqueue as an escape hatch for tiny requests when continuous batching starves them. thinking through tradeoffs.
jon park: curious, how does microqueue interact with current admission? do we early-ack or fastpath?
maria chen: prefer fastpath (no change to caller semantics). microqueue = tiny-window dedicated queue with strict headroom + token budget per tenant.
samir patel: ok but what happens on fence events when tenant is moved to microqueue? kv-cache misses will spike and could make tail worse. need warmup.
kevin li: add a small async warmup that replays N recent prefixes (read-only) tagged `warmup=true`. runtime skips billing & side effects. cap rate so it doesn't add pressure.
j on park: +1 to warmup. also need eviction policy for microqueue: oldest vs low-priority. I prefer evict low-priority first.
maria chen: we should add a priority bit to the request envelope: streaming:true/false and priority:0-3. default 1. scheduler uses it for eviction.
samir patel: telemetry required: fence triggers, microqueue evictions (reason, priority), warmup success/failure, kv miss rate post-fence.
jon park: threshold for fence? operator knob X by tenant qps or token burn rate. also per-AZ feature flag so we can experiment.
kevin li: implement envelope change + runtime knob. will keep fallback mapping off by default but add support to route to cheaper model variant if microqueue overwhelmed >T.
maria chen: potential hazard: prewarming could accidentally run user ops. be explicit: warmup must call model runtime in read-only path; no hooks, no billing, no external callbacks.
samir patel: agree. prototype plan: Ill mock microqueue in code path that demotes requests to microqueue and simulate warmup with replay of last 8 prefixes.
jon park: timeline? can we have a PoC in a week for staging perf runs?
kevin li: yes, Ill land envelope + feature flag.
maria chen: action list: (1) microqueue + per-tenant token budgets; (2) priority bit in envelope; (3) warmup job on fence transition (N=8 default); (4) telemetry dashboards & SLI sim; (5) feature flag `microqueue-experiment`; (6) optional fallback to cheaper model by tenant tier.
ops-bot: deploy-batcher-poc v2 applied to staging. perf-tests queued. :rocket:
jon park: one more thought 1: what about gradual ramp of warmup so we don't overload the runtime when many tenants are fenced simultaneously? backlog warmup queue with rate-limiter per-AZ.
samir patel: implement warmup queue with token bucket; backoff if runtime reports high cpu/gpu util.
kevin li: noted. I'll add operator knobs for warmup rate and N.
maria chen: great. I'll write a short RFC follow-up summarizing decisions and publish to #eng-runtime. please add short test plans in the PRs.
jon park: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: staging perf run: microqueue disabled baseline p99=310ms; microqueue+warmup stub p99=235ms (prelim). more verification pending.
maria chen: thanks team, keep updates here and in the RFC doc.
